jobs.title: Senior Director, Analytics and Data Science, Core Product & Growth
jobs.description:
About Life360

Life360's mission is to keep people close to the ones they love. Our category-leading mobile app, Tile tracking devices, and Pet GPS tracker empower members to protect the people, pets, and things they care about most with a range of services, including location sharing, safe driver reports, and crash detection with emergency dispatch. Life360 serves approximately 102.4 million monthly active users (MAU), as of June 30, 2026, across more than 180 countries.

Life360 delivers peace of mind and enhances everyday family life with seamless coordination for all the moments that matter, big and small. By continuing to innovate and deliver for our customers, we have become a household name and the must-have mobile-based membership for families (and those friends who are basically family).

Life360 has more than 500 (and growing!) remote-first employees. For more information, please visit life360.com.

Life360 is a Remote First company, which means a remote work environment will be the primary experience for all employees. All positions, unless otherwise specified, can be performed remotely (within the US and Canada) regardless of any specified location above.

We are AI Native

We are building an AI native company where AI is an integral part of how we build and operate. AI tool usage during interviews varies by role. You may be asked to demonstrate proficiency with AI tools, discuss how you leverage AI, or complete interview exercises without AI assistance. Your Recruiter will provide clear guidance as you move through the interview process.

Undisclosed use of AI not previously discussed with or approved by your Recruiter may impact your candidacy.

About The Team

The Data & Analytics Team (DnA) is a 60+ person organization spanning data engineering, analytics engineering, analytics/decision science, and data science/ML. The science teams are organized into two sub teams, focusing on MAU and Revenue. This role leads decision science and data science within MAU.

You and your team will be responsible for understanding the drivers behind MAU: why members come, why they stay, and why they return. The team partners with product, marketing, and engineering to put those learnings into everyday work, and that work shapes our roadmaps.

Our data is unusual for a consumer company. Life360 measures families and circles rather than individuals, so one member's behavior affects another's, which makes measurement a different problem than a standard funnel. With billions of location events, driving behavior, crash detection, and Tile and Pet GPS trackers, we get a rich picture of physical behavior that few consumer companies can build.

About The Job

This Senior Director leads MAU Analytics and Data Science.

You and your team will work across acquisition, activation, engagement, and retention on the analysis, models, and experiments behind each. A lot of what this role owns needs to be built rather than maintained: the measurement, the standards, and how the team uses AI. The team is also raising its craft, and coaching people through that is an important part of the job. Within a year, your team members will be operating at an elevated skill level, proactively bringing key questions to light, and serving as trusted advisors whom stakeholders consult for strategic guidance rather than simple task execution.

You will report to the Head of Data and work closely with counterparts leading Revenue Analytics and Data Science, and with the leaders of Data Engineering.

For candidates based in the US, the salary range for this position is $247,000 to $366,000 USD. For candidates based out of Canada, the salary range for this position is $286,000 to $339,000 CAD.
We take into consideration an individual's background, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience in determining final salary. Base pay may also vary based on geographic location, with US work locations falling into one of three geographic tiers.

Total compensation is inclusive of equity compensation in the form of Restricted Stock Units (RSUs)
, as well as a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, financial, and other benefits.

What You'll Do

Lead and develop the decision scientists and data scientists on the team, and set the quality bar for both disciplines.
Own the MAU driver model and the forecast.
Own the exploratory work that drives the strategy to grow MAU.
Establish how an analysis gets scoped, run, reviewed, and written up, so its quality does not depend on who picked up the request.
Partner with your Revenue counterpart and Data Engineering leadership to define common metrics, align on experimentation standards, and introduce unified operating practices across teams.
Build the operating model that gets the team into the roadmap conversation early, with a view on what to build and what to test.
Use agents and automated analysis daily, and expect the same of the team.
Shape how the team works AI-native: what gets delegated to agents, what gets automated, and what stays human judgment.

What We're Looking For

Required Experience & Qualifications

10+ years in analytics, data science, or decision science, including 5+ years in people management in a senior leadership role.
Deep expertise in inferential and causal analytics. Able to lead ML practitioners.
Expert knowledge of engagement, retention, churn, and cohort metrics.
Experience forecasting a company-level metric and being held to it.
SQL, plus Python or R.
Experience with Databricks, third party experimentation tools (e.g. Statsig), Tableau or similar BI tools, and AI native BI tools (e.g. Hex, AI/BI).
Hands-on with coding agents (Claude Code or equivalent) in your own analytical work.
Bachelor's degree or equivalent.

Nice to Have

Familiarity with experiment design to identify and control for network effects.
Master’s degree or PhD with an emphasis in social science, psychology or other behavioral science.
Experience leading a team that reports to you but sits embedded with product and engineering teams.
Experience in a B2C subscription business.

Core Expectations

You have moved an analytics team from reactive to embedded.
You coach and develop people, and you have grown analysts into leaders.
On your teams, analysis starts from a hypothesis rather than a data request.
You have built the standards a team works from, and got people to use them.
You are curious about why people behave the way they do, not just what they did.
You decide what the team does not work on, and you can defend it.

Our Benefits

Medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance plans (100% paid for US employees). We offer life and disability as well as supplemental plans for medical and dental for Canadian employees.
401(k) plan with company matching program in the US and RRSP with DPSP plan for Canadian employees.
Paid parental leave
Mental Wellness Program & Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for mental well-being
Generous time off: flexible PTO, companywide holidays throughout the year plus summer and winter shutdowns
Learning & Development programs
Equipment, tools, and reimbursement support for a productive remote environment.
Free Life360 Platinum Membership and Tile trackers.

Life360 Values

Our company's mission-driven culture is guided by our shared values to create a trusted work environment where you can bring your authentic self to work and make a positive difference

Be a Good Person - We have a team of high integrity people you can trust.
Be Direct With Respect - We communicate directly, even when it's hard.
Members Before Metrics - We focus on building an exceptional experience for families.
High Intensity, High Impact - We do whatever it takes to get the job done.

Our Commitment to Diversity

We believe that different ideas, perspectives and backgrounds create a stronger and more creative work environment that delivers better results. Together, we continue to build an inclusive culture that encourages, supports, and celebrates the diverse voices of our employees. It fuels our innovation and connects us closer to our customers and the communities we serve. We strive to create a workplace that reflects the communities we serve and where everyone feels empowered to bring their authentic best selves to work.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at Life360. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any legally protected status.

We encourage people of all backgrounds to apply. We believe that a diversity of perspectives and experiences create a foundation for the best ideas. Come join us in building something meaningful. Even if you don't meet 100% of the below qualifications, you should still seriously consider applying!

jobs.title: Senior Director, AI Research- EN
jobs.description:
Job Description

What is the opportunity?

RBC's AI Group is building the future of AI-powered banking, and our research teams are at the forefront of this transformation. Reporting to the VP, Applied AI Research & Solutions, the Senior Director, AI Research will lead a team of world-class machine learning researchers and research engineers to develop cutting-edge AI algorithms that directly power RBC's products and services.

This is a unique opportunity to bridge frontier AI research with real-world business impact. You'll work at the intersection of innovation and application by translating the latest advances in machine learning into production-ready solutions that serve millions of clients across credit, fraud detection, market intelligence, pricing optimization, and generative AI applications.

As a member of RBC Borealis AI, you'll leverage RBC's unique data assets and strategic partnerships to push the boundaries of what's possible in AI, while ensuring your work delivers measurable business value aligned with RBC's $1 billion AI ambition.

What will you do?

AI Research Leadership:

Lead and mentor a high-performing team of AI researchers and research engineers, fostering a culture of innovation, collaboration, and impact-driven solutions.
Direct the development of novel machine learning algorithms and models across one or more domains: credit risk, fraud detection, market prediction, pricing & optimization, or generative/agentic AI. Leverage RBC and external data to deliver differentiating solutions and intellectual property to the business.
Define AI roadmaps with ML models that balance advancing the state-of-the-art with delivering tangible business outcomes aligned to RBC's strategic priorities.
Build and retain top-tier AI talent by creating an environment that attracts leading researchers from both academia and industry.
Act as a thought leader and partner to RBC businesses and functions and advise on the art of the possible for AI in these domains.
Evaluate new areas for AI investment, complete proof of concept testing and evaluation.

Applied Research & Business Impact:

Partner closely with the VP, AI Research and Innovation team to operationalize frontier research and translate breakthroughs into applied solutions.
Collaborate with VP, Solutions Engineering & Delivery to ensure AI algorithms are production-ready, scalable, and integrated seamlessly into RBC's enterprise platforms.
Drive rapid experimentation and iteration to test and validate models against real-world business problems, ensuring measurable ROI.
Develop intellectual property and publish research findings that position RBC as a thought leader in AI innovation.

Cross-Functional Collaboration:

Act as a trusted technical advisor to business partners across RBC's lines of business, translating complex AI concepts into actionable insights.
Work with platform teams to leverage RBC's AI & data infrastructure (Lumina) for model development, training, and deployment.
Partner with AI Governance & Evaluation teams to ensure all models meet regulatory, ethical, and compliance standards.
Engage with external research communities, academic institutions, and industry partners to stay ahead of emerging AI trends and technologies.
Champion responsible AI practices, embedding fairness, transparency, and bias mitigation into the research lifecycle.
Identify opportunities to advance RBC's AI capabilities through experimentation with emerging technologies (e.g., foundation models, multimodal AI, reinforcement learning).
Contribute to RBC's AI thought leadership through publications, patents, conference presentations, and community engagement.
In this role, you will communicate and interact frequently with RBC partners and/or employees located across Canada and/or worldwide.

What do you need to succeed?

Must Have:

PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related field, or equivalent industry experience.
10+ years of experience developing and deploying machine learning models in industry settings, with at least 3-5 years in leadership roles and people management.
Experience translating research prototypes into production-grade solutions at scale, preferably in regulated industries (financial services, healthcare, etc.).
Strong publication record and recognized thought leadership in AI/ML (conference papers, patents, technical blogs, or open-source contributions).
Demonstrated ability to collaborate across technical and non-technical stakeholders, communicating complex concepts clearly to senior leadership.

What's in it for you?

We thrive on the challenge to be our best, progressive thinking to keep growing, and working together to deliver trusted advice to help our clients thrive and communities prosper. We care about each other, reaching our potential, making a difference to our communities, and achieving success that is mutual.

Work at the cutting edge of AI: Access to RBC's unique data assets, world-class compute infrastructure, and strategic partnerships with leading AI research institutions.
Industry-leading research environment: Publish your work, attend top-tier conferences, and collaborate with renowned researchers from RBC Borealis and beyond.
Real-world impact: Your research will directly power products and services used by millions of clients across Canada and globally.
Comprehensive Total Rewards Program including competitive compensation, bonuses, flexible benefits, and stock options.
Talent development: Leaders who support your growth through coaching, mentorship, and opportunities to shape RBC's AI strategy.
Dynamic, high-performing team: Work alongside some of the brightest minds in AI, machine learning, and financial services.
Opportunities for progressively greater impact: Shape the future of AI at one of the world's leading financial institutions.

jobs.description:
Job Description

Title:
Director, Finance (CSM)

Id:
21596

Type:
FullTime

At Husky TechnologiesTM, our success is based on your success. Our ability to keep our customers in the lead is based on building the strongest team possible.

Husky TechnologiesTM has a strong foundation built on innovation, close customer relationships and a unique culture and values. We are dedicated to offering our customers the highest quality products and services and are looking for people with the inspiration and talent to develop with us as we pursue our ambitious growth strategy. We are a leader in developing state-of-the-art technology and it is this technology base that uniquely positions us to serve customers who seek differentiation through solutions that provide speed, flexibility and maximum productivity. This capability is at the core of our mission and competitive strategy.

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a wealth of opportunity for personal growth and development. Most importantly, Husky Technologies TM offers an opportunity to work with – and be challenged by – a team of great people. Our success is possible because of the creativity, intelligence and passion of our people around the world and their desire to lead change. At the same time, we are not afraid to expect a lot and strive for leadership in all of our key markets. We are a company taking on new challenges and for the right people this means exceptional career development opportunities, the chance to be part of a team that is the best in the world at what we do and the experience that comes from working in an environment that demands constant transformation and innovation.

Husky TechnologiesTM is an exciting company with tremendous potential. We have a great team and great expectations. If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution – then we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team!

The Finance Director serves as a strategic business partner to the Leadership Team in support of Husky’s Global Service Business and Customer Success Management strategy. This role provides leadership for financial planning, forecasting, performance analysis, governance, and decision support to drive profitable growth, improve operational performance, and strengthen financial visibility across service revenue streams, including field service, contracts, parts, and other aftermarket offerings. The Finance Director is expected to influence strategic decisions, lead transformation initiatives, and build a high-performing finance capability that enables the business to scale effectively.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Planning & Forecasting

Lead the annual budget, quarterly forecast, and long-range planning processes for the service business.
Develop robust revenue, margin, cost, and headcount forecasts based on operational and commercial drivers.
Translate business strategies into financial plans with clear assumptions, risks, and opportunities.
Support scenario planning and sensitivity analysis for service growth, pricing, labor utilization, and investment decisions.

Performance Management & Analysis

Deliver timely and accurate monthly financial reporting and variance analysis for service revenue, gross margin, SG&A, and operating income.
Analyze business performance by region, product line, customer segment, channel, and service offering.
Monitor and explain key drivers of performance, including labor utilization, absorption, contract profitability, attach rates, response times, and service productivity.
Provide actionable insights and recommendations to improve growth, profitability, and working capital performance.

Business Partnering

Serve as the senior finance partner to service leadership, operations, commercial teams, and Customer Success leaders, providing insight and challenge on strategic priorities, business performance, and investment decisions.
Lead financial evaluation of pricing strategies, contract renewals, service program design, and capital or operating investments to support sustainable growth and margin expansion.
Provide proactive challenge and decision support to business leaders by identifying risks, opportunities, and trade-offs across growth, productivity, service delivery, and resource allocation.
Lead cross-functional evaluation of new service offerings, business models, and transformation initiatives that improve service coverage, utilization, fulfillment, cost efficiency, and customer value.
Sponsor finance and business transformation initiatives across Finance and Customer Success Management, including enhancements to processes, reporting, operating metrics, and decision frameworks that support growth, profitability, and scalability.

Management Reporting & KPI Development

Develop and enhance dashboards, reporting tools, and KPIs that improve transparency and decision-making.
Standardize definitions and reporting for critical service metrics across the organization.
Improve reporting automation and self-service analytics capabilities where possible.
Present clear financial results and business insights to senior leadership

Process Improvement & Governance

Strengthen forecasting accuracy, reporting discipline, and financial controls within the service business.
Drive continuous improvement in FP&A processes, planning models, and reporting frameworks.
Ensure alignment with corporate finance requirements, accounting policies, and internal controls
Support month-end close and planning processes in partnership with accounting and finance teams.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field required.
CPA, CMA, CFA, or MBA preferred.
10+ years of progressive experience in FP&A, finance business partnering, commercial finance, or operational finance, including leadership responsibility.
Experience in a service, aftermarket, field service, maintenance, or contract-based business strongly preferred.
Strong financial modeling, forecasting, and business analysis skills.
Advanced proficiency in Excel and experience with ERP and planning/reporting systems.
Executive presence with strong communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, and the ability to influence senior leaders across functions and regions.
Proven ability to work cross-functionally in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment

Preferred Experience In a Service Business

Understanding of service revenue models such as time and materials, service contracts, preventive maintenance, subscriptions, and parts/service bundles.
Experience analyzing operational KPIs such as technician utilization, service efficiency, contract margins, backlog, renewal rates, and service attach rates.
Familiarity with pricing strategy, labor productivity, installed base analytics, and customer lifecycle economics

Core Competencies

Strategic leadership
Financial and commercial acumen
Analytical rigor
Executive business partnership
Influence and executive communication
Problem solving
Process improvement
Results orientation and a bias for action

Team Development

Build and lead a high-performing finance team with strong capability in financial analysis, strategic thinking, business partnership, and change leadership.
Lead, coach, and develop team members, including succession planning, capability building, and development of future finance leaders.

Financial Leadership

Provide consistent, timely, accurate, and decision-oriented financial reporting for the service business, with greater automation and self-service access to insights where possible

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a competitive compensation and benefits package and excellent opportunities for growth and advancement. We are committed to equal employment opportunity and respect, value and welcome diversity in our workplace. Husky Technologies TM also values being a great place to work and strives to maintain a safe workplace. Accordingly, Husky TechnologiesTM conditions all offers of employment on satisfactory completion of background checks.

Husky TechnologiesTM is committed to developing inclusive, barrier-free selection processes and work environments. If contacted in relation to a job opportunity or testing, you should advise the member of the Talent Acquisition team in a timely fashion of any disabilities that requires accommodation measures in order to enable you to be assessed in a fair and equitable manner.

Information received relating to accommodation measures will be addressed confidentially.

No agency or telephone inquiries please.

jobs.description:
Corporate Finance Team Overview:

The Corporate Finance team within Canadian Commercial Banking, is part of BMO Financial group and covers both public and large private corporate clients operating in diversified industries. The team is responsible for marketing, managing, and monitoring large commercial loan portfolios, and also supporting credit requirements and cross selling efforts for other businesses including subordinated debt, equipment leasing, derivatives, cash management, and trade finance. The team assesses financing opportunities of $10,000,000 or more, both on a syndicated and bilateral basis.

Job Overview

The Associate Director plays a critical role in supporting the growth and risk‑management objectives of the portfolio. This role requires a combination of advanced financial analysis, strong credit analysis and relationship management abilities. Associate Directors contribute to client decisioning, credit structuring, and portfolio oversight, while also supporting new business development and delivering a superior client experience. Work is performed in close partnership with Managing Director and/or Director. The deal team is responsible for marketing, managing, and monitoring large commercial loan portfolios, and also supporting credit requirements and cross selling efforts for other businesses including subordinated debt, equipment leasing, derivatives, cash management, and trade finance. The team assesses financing opportunities of $10,000,000 or more, both on a syndicated and bilateral basis.

Analyzes credit information to support lending decisions and processes for new and existing Commercial banking loans and credit solutions in an assigned portfolio of clients. Makes credit decisions and recommendations in compliance with bank policies and procedures while maintaining an exceptional client service environment.

Negotiates loan structures and terms and conditions that align client requirements with the bank risk appetite and policies.
Assesses client repayment capacity by utilizing financial models and analytical tools to recommend appropriate loan structures and collateral requirements.
Signs off on new, renewal and extension loans within delegated authority.
Monitors portfolio to identify deteriorating credit conditions and compliance, analyses metrics, and assesses broader industry trends to spot risks and opportunities.
Evaluates portfolio performance and recommends capital allocation strategies that optimize returns with investment objectives.
Leads proposal development and delivers presentations to capture new business and expand client relationships.
Networks with industry contacts to gather competitive insights and best practices.
Develops and executes business development plans focused on enhancing client relationships and growth opportunities within the portfolio.
Builds and maintains client relationships to ensure long-term financial performance in collaboration with Relationship Manager and business partners.
Structures and supports new, renewal and extension loans aligned with client needs and bank & risk policies
Conducts financial analysis and risk assessments of clients’ credit information, for an assigned portfolio, to provide insights and make informed decisions
Monitors the portfolio performance for assigned portfolio of Commercial Banking clients on an ongoing basis, taking corrective action when required.
Minimizes BMO’s risk exposure by adhering to credit policies, regulatory standards, and operational guidelines.
Serves as a point of contact for service requests, ensuring expectations are consistently met or exceeded. Escalates issues when needed.
Supports and implements initiatives to enhance service quality, acquire new business and expand client relationships.
Identifies revenue and cross-selling opportunities to enhance portfolio growth.
Identifies share of wallet opportunities.
Leverages analysis tools to nurture and grow a portfolio that exceeds ROE thresholds and evaluates client returns on a proactive basis.
Manages timely and accurate data entry into BMO's systems and leverages the data to support decision-making.
Focus is primarily on business/group within BMO; may have broader, enterprise-wide focus.
Provides specialized consulting, analytical and technical support.
Exercises judgment to identify, diagnose, and solve problems within given rules.
Works independently and regularly handles non-routine situations.
Broader work or accountabilities may be assigned as needed.
Take measured risks while protecting the bank by applying our Risk Management Framework in the execution of your role, in line with our Risk Culture and within our approved Risk Appetite, making sound and risk informed decisions that align to business strategy, protect assets, and adhere to applicable policy documents (Frameworks, Policies, Standards, Procedures and Supporting documents), laws and regulations.

Qualifications:

Preferred 5 – 7 years of relevant experience in credit or lending instruments or financial operations in a corporate or banking environment.
If a Credit Qualifiable job, Credit Qualifications and associated credit knowledge and skills according to the credit portfolio requirements and qualification standards.
Bachelor’s degree required; Business Administration, Finance and Accounting preferred. Any other related discipline or commensurate work experience considered.
Deep knowledge and technical proficiency gained through extensive education and business experience.

Structuring Deals

Advanced level of proficiency:

Problem Solving
Collaboration
Detail-Oriented
Customer Service
Loan Structuring
Regulatory Compliance
Portfolio Management
Credit Risk Assessment
Banking Operations
Microsoft Office

Financial analysis

$70,000.00 - $150,000.00

Pay Type:

Salaried

Salaries will vary based on factors such as location, skills, experience, education, and qualifications for the role, and may include a commission structure. Salaries for part-time roles will be pro-rated based on number of hours regularly worked. For commission roles, the salary listed above represents BMO Financial Group’s expected target for the first year in this position.

BMO Financial Group’s total compensation package will vary based on the pay type of the position and may include performance-based incentives, discretionary bonuses, as well as other perks and rewards. BMO also offers health insurance, tuition reimbursement, accident and life insurance, and retirement savings plans. At BMO we are driven by a shared Purpose: Boldly Grow the Good in business and life. It calls on us to create lasting, positive change for our customers, our communities and our people. By working together, innovating and pushing boundaries, we transform lives and businesses, and power economic growth around the world.

As a member of the BMO team you are valued, respected and heard, and you have more ways to grow and make an impact. We strive to help you make an impact from day one – for yourself and our customers. We’ll support you with the tools and resources you need to reach new milestones, as you help our customers reach theirs. From in-depth training and coaching, to manager support and network-building opportunities, we’ll help you gain valuable experience, and broaden your skillset.

jobs.title: Director, Consulting Services - Growth and Strategy
jobs.description:
Position Description

Ready to join an organization that values innovation, inclusion, community involvement, and the opportunity to influence decisions?

CGI is more than an IT company. We combine local relationships and accountability with access to global capabilities, industry expertise, and delivery talent. CGI offers a competitive total rewards package that includes a share purchase program, profit sharing, professional development programs and flexible work arrangements.

CGI Edmonton is seeking an experienced Director, Consulting Services – Growth & Strategy to help build and scale our commercial business in the Edmonton market.

This is a leadership role focused on originating net new executive relationships, identifying client priorities, shaping differentiated consulting and technology opportunities, and closing profitable engagements that create long-term client value, recurring revenue, and future backlog.

This role is suited to a true market builder, someone who creates opportunities rather than waits for them, can open doors at the executive level, and has the commercial discipline to move opportunities from initial conversation through contract signature and successful transition to delivery.

Your future duties and responsibilities

Success in this role will be measured by the Director's ability to:

Establish meaningful executive relationships within priority Edmonton accounts.
Create qualified opportunities rather than relying primarily on inbound demand.
Convert client priorities into differentiated, commercially viable CGI solutions.
Build and maintain a credible pipeline with clear client-supported next steps.
Win new clients and expand initial engagements into long-term relationships.
Deliver signed bookings and profitable backlog that contribute to future revenue growth.
Maintain accurate forecasts and strong commercial discipline.
Mobilize CGI's broader organization effectively in a matrixed environment.

Required Qualifications To Be Successful In This Role

10 or more years of experience in complex business-to-business technology, consulting, or managed services sales, account growth, or consulting leadership.
Significant recent experience developing business within Edmonton or the broader Alberta market.
An established network of relationships within Edmonton and Alberta's commercial business community.
A proven record of building qualified pipeline and achieving or exceeding sales, bookings, or revenue objectives.
Experience engaging and influencing C-suite executives, senior business leaders, CIOs, CTOs, CFOs, and operational decision makers.
Experience positioning and selling services such as business consulting, systems integration, application development, data and AI, modernization, cybersecurity, or multi-year application management services.
Strong commercial and financial acumen, including experience with pricing, cost models, contribution margin, contracting and opportunity risk.
Strong written, verbal, presentation, facilitation and negotiation skills.
Ability to maintain a regular in-market presence with clients and the Edmonton business community.

Leadership attributes

A proactive, entrepreneurial approach to market development.
Strong consultative selling and executive relationship skills.
The ability to listen carefully, understand business problems, and translate them into actionable opportunities.
Commercial discipline and a willingness to qualify out opportunities that do not warrant investment.
Creativity in developing solutions, value propositions and paths into new accounts.
Resilience, personal accountability and comfort operating in an evolving growth environment.
The ability to influence and mobilize people without relying on direct reporting authority.
A collaborative approach that balances individual sales accountability with one team outcomes.
A commitment to client value, delivery credibility, and long-term relationships.

Education

Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Business Administration, Management Information Systems, Computer Science or a related discipline.
An equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience will also be considered (10+ years).

CGI is providing a reasonable estimate of the pay range for this role. The determination of this range includes various factors, including but not limited to skill set level, geographic market, experience and training, and licenses and certifications. Compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $110,000 - $215,000.

Why CGI

At CGI, you will have the opportunity to shape a new growth portfolio while drawing on the capabilities of a global organization. You will work with experienced leaders, consulting and technology specialists, and delivery teams to help Edmonton organizations address meaningful business priorities.

new_jobs.title: Senior Director, Analytics and Data Science, Core Product & Growth
new_jobs.description:
About Life360

Life360's mission is to keep people close to the ones they love. Our category-leading mobile app, Tile tracking devices, and Pet GPS tracker empower members to protect the people, pets, and things they care about most with a range of services, including location sharing, safe driver reports, and crash detection with emergency dispatch. Life360 serves approximately 102.4 million monthly active users (MAU), as of June 30, 2026, across more than 180 countries.

Life360 delivers peace of mind and enhances everyday family life with seamless coordination for all the moments that matter, big and small. By continuing to innovate and deliver for our customers, we have become a household name and the must-have mobile-based membership for families (and those friends who are basically family).

Life360 has more than 500 (and growing!) remote-first employees. For more information, please visit life360.com.

Life360 is a Remote First company, which means a remote work environment will be the primary experience for all employees. All positions, unless otherwise specified, can be performed remotely (within the US and Canada) regardless of any specified location above.

We are AI Native

We are building an AI native company where AI is an integral part of how we build and operate. AI tool usage during interviews varies by role. You may be asked to demonstrate proficiency with AI tools, discuss how you leverage AI, or complete interview exercises without AI assistance. Your Recruiter will provide clear guidance as you move through the interview process.

Undisclosed use of AI not previously discussed with or approved by your Recruiter may impact your candidacy.

About The Team

The Data & Analytics Team (DnA) is a 60+ person organization spanning data engineering, analytics engineering, analytics/decision science, and data science/ML. The science teams are organized into two sub teams, focusing on MAU and Revenue. This role leads decision science and data science within MAU.

You and your team will be responsible for understanding the drivers behind MAU: why members come, why they stay, and why they return. The team partners with product, marketing, and engineering to put those learnings into everyday work, and that work shapes our roadmaps.

Our data is unusual for a consumer company. Life360 measures families and circles rather than individuals, so one member's behavior affects another's, which makes measurement a different problem than a standard funnel. With billions of location events, driving behavior, crash detection, and Tile and Pet GPS trackers, we get a rich picture of physical behavior that few consumer companies can build.

About The Job

This Senior Director leads MAU Analytics and Data Science.

You and your team will work across acquisition, activation, engagement, and retention on the analysis, models, and experiments behind each. A lot of what this role owns needs to be built rather than maintained: the measurement, the standards, and how the team uses AI. The team is also raising its craft, and coaching people through that is an important part of the job. Within a year, your team members will be operating at an elevated skill level, proactively bringing key questions to light, and serving as trusted advisors whom stakeholders consult for strategic guidance rather than simple task execution.

You will report to the Head of Data and work closely with counterparts leading Revenue Analytics and Data Science, and with the leaders of Data Engineering.

For candidates based in the US, the salary range for this position is $247,000 to $366,000 USD. For candidates based out of Canada, the salary range for this position is $286,000 to $339,000 CAD.
We take into consideration an individual's background, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience in determining final salary. Base pay may also vary based on geographic location, with US work locations falling into one of three geographic tiers.

Total compensation is inclusive of equity compensation in the form of Restricted Stock Units (RSUs)
, as well as a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, financial, and other benefits.

What You'll Do

Lead and develop the decision scientists and data scientists on the team, and set the quality bar for both disciplines.
Own the MAU driver model and the forecast.
Own the exploratory work that drives the strategy to grow MAU.
Establish how an analysis gets scoped, run, reviewed, and written up, so its quality does not depend on who picked up the request.
Partner with your Revenue counterpart and Data Engineering leadership to define common metrics, align on experimentation standards, and introduce unified operating practices across teams.
Build the operating model that gets the team into the roadmap conversation early, with a view on what to build and what to test.
Use agents and automated analysis daily, and expect the same of the team.
Shape how the team works AI-native: what gets delegated to agents, what gets automated, and what stays human judgment.

What We're Looking For

Required Experience & Qualifications

10+ years in analytics, data science, or decision science, including 5+ years in people management in a senior leadership role.
Deep expertise in inferential and causal analytics. Able to lead ML practitioners.
Expert knowledge of engagement, retention, churn, and cohort metrics.
Experience forecasting a company-level metric and being held to it.
SQL, plus Python or R.
Experience with Databricks, third party experimentation tools (e.g. Statsig), Tableau or similar BI tools, and AI native BI tools (e.g. Hex, AI/BI).
Hands-on with coding agents (Claude Code or equivalent) in your own analytical work.
Bachelor's degree or equivalent.

Nice to Have

Familiarity with experiment design to identify and control for network effects.
Master’s degree or PhD with an emphasis in social science, psychology or other behavioral science.
Experience leading a team that reports to you but sits embedded with product and engineering teams.
Experience in a B2C subscription business.

Core Expectations

You have moved an analytics team from reactive to embedded.
You coach and develop people, and you have grown analysts into leaders.
On your teams, analysis starts from a hypothesis rather than a data request.
You have built the standards a team works from, and got people to use them.
You are curious about why people behave the way they do, not just what they did.
You decide what the team does not work on, and you can defend it.

Our Benefits

Medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance plans (100% paid for US employees). We offer life and disability as well as supplemental plans for medical and dental for Canadian employees.
401(k) plan with company matching program in the US and RRSP with DPSP plan for Canadian employees.
Paid parental leave
Mental Wellness Program & Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for mental well-being
Generous time off: flexible PTO, companywide holidays throughout the year plus summer and winter shutdowns
Learning & Development programs
Equipment, tools, and reimbursement support for a productive remote environment.
Free Life360 Platinum Membership and Tile trackers.

Life360 Values

Our company's mission-driven culture is guided by our shared values to create a trusted work environment where you can bring your authentic self to work and make a positive difference

Be a Good Person - We have a team of high integrity people you can trust.
Be Direct With Respect - We communicate directly, even when it's hard.
Members Before Metrics - We focus on building an exceptional experience for families.
High Intensity, High Impact - We do whatever it takes to get the job done.

Our Commitment to Diversity

We believe that different ideas, perspectives and backgrounds create a stronger and more creative work environment that delivers better results. Together, we continue to build an inclusive culture that encourages, supports, and celebrates the diverse voices of our employees. It fuels our innovation and connects us closer to our customers and the communities we serve. We strive to create a workplace that reflects the communities we serve and where everyone feels empowered to bring their authentic best selves to work.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at Life360. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any legally protected status.

We encourage people of all backgrounds to apply. We believe that a diversity of perspectives and experiences create a foundation for the best ideas. Come join us in building something meaningful. Even if you don't meet 100% of the below qualifications, you should still seriously consider applying!

new_jobs.description:
Job Description

What is the opportunity?

RBC's AI Group is building the future of AI-powered banking, and our research teams are at the forefront of this transformation. Reporting to the VP, Applied AI Research & Solutions, the Senior Director, AI Research will lead a team of world-class machine learning researchers and research engineers to develop cutting-edge AI algorithms that directly power RBC's products and services.

This is a unique opportunity to bridge frontier AI research with real-world business impact. You'll work at the intersection of innovation and application by translating the latest advances in machine learning into production-ready solutions that serve millions of clients across credit, fraud detection, market intelligence, pricing optimization, and generative AI applications.

As a member of RBC Borealis AI, you'll leverage RBC's unique data assets and strategic partnerships to push the boundaries of what's possible in AI, while ensuring your work delivers measurable business value aligned with RBC's $1 billion AI ambition.

What will you do?

AI Research Leadership:

Lead and mentor a high-performing team of AI researchers and research engineers, fostering a culture of innovation, collaboration, and impact-driven solutions.
Direct the development of novel machine learning algorithms and models across one or more domains: credit risk, fraud detection, market prediction, pricing & optimization, or generative/agentic AI. Leverage RBC and external data to deliver differentiating solutions and intellectual property to the business.
Define AI roadmaps with ML models that balance advancing the state-of-the-art with delivering tangible business outcomes aligned to RBC's strategic priorities.
Build and retain top-tier AI talent by creating an environment that attracts leading researchers from both academia and industry.
Act as a thought leader and partner to RBC businesses and functions and advise on the art of the possible for AI in these domains.
Evaluate new areas for AI investment, complete proof of concept testing and evaluation.

Applied Research & Business Impact:

Partner closely with the VP, AI Research and Innovation team to operationalize frontier research and translate breakthroughs into applied solutions.
Collaborate with VP, Solutions Engineering & Delivery to ensure AI algorithms are production-ready, scalable, and integrated seamlessly into RBC's enterprise platforms.
Drive rapid experimentation and iteration to test and validate models against real-world business problems, ensuring measurable ROI.
Develop intellectual property and publish research findings that position RBC as a thought leader in AI innovation.

Cross-Functional Collaboration:

Act as a trusted technical advisor to business partners across RBC's lines of business, translating complex AI concepts into actionable insights.
Work with platform teams to leverage RBC's AI & data infrastructure (Lumina) for model development, training, and deployment.
Partner with AI Governance & Evaluation teams to ensure all models meet regulatory, ethical, and compliance standards.
Engage with external research communities, academic institutions, and industry partners to stay ahead of emerging AI trends and technologies.
Champion responsible AI practices, embedding fairness, transparency, and bias mitigation into the research lifecycle.
Identify opportunities to advance RBC's AI capabilities through experimentation with emerging technologies (e.g., foundation models, multimodal AI, reinforcement learning).
Contribute to RBC's AI thought leadership through publications, patents, conference presentations, and community engagement.
In this role, you will communicate and interact frequently with RBC partners and/or employees located across Canada and/or worldwide.

What do you need to succeed?

Must Have:

PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related field, or equivalent industry experience.
10+ years of experience developing and deploying machine learning models in industry settings, with at least 3-5 years in leadership roles and people management.
Experience translating research prototypes into production-grade solutions at scale, preferably in regulated industries (financial services, healthcare, etc.).
Strong publication record and recognized thought leadership in AI/ML (conference papers, patents, technical blogs, or open-source contributions).
Demonstrated ability to collaborate across technical and non-technical stakeholders, communicating complex concepts clearly to senior leadership.

What's in it for you?

We thrive on the challenge to be our best, progressive thinking to keep growing, and working together to deliver trusted advice to help our clients thrive and communities prosper. We care about each other, reaching our potential, making a difference to our communities, and achieving success that is mutual.

Work at the cutting edge of AI: Access to RBC's unique data assets, world-class compute infrastructure, and strategic partnerships with leading AI research institutions.
Industry-leading research environment: Publish your work, attend top-tier conferences, and collaborate with renowned researchers from RBC Borealis and beyond.
Real-world impact: Your research will directly power products and services used by millions of clients across Canada and globally.
Comprehensive Total Rewards Program including competitive compensation, bonuses, flexible benefits, and stock options.
Talent development: Leaders who support your growth through coaching, mentorship, and opportunities to shape RBC's AI strategy.
Dynamic, high-performing team: Work alongside some of the brightest minds in AI, machine learning, and financial services.
Opportunities for progressively greater impact: Shape the future of AI at one of the world's leading financial institutions.
